MODELS-0001.title: Filtering by channel narrows the version list
MODELS-0001.objective: Confirm choosing a channel filter shows only versions currently in that state.
MODELS-0001.precondition: User is signed in as admin and is on the Models screen.

steps.name: Choose the Staging filter
steps.expected: Only versions currently deployed to staging are listed.
steps.actual: Staging filter selected; only 1.0.0-seeds-v2 (deployed to staging) is listed.

steps.name: Choose the Archived filter
steps.expected: Only archived versions are listed (or an empty-state message if none exist).
steps.actual: Archived filter selected; empty state 'No matching versions' shown (no archived versions exist).

MODELS-0002.title: Deploying a candidate version to a channel succeeds
MODELS-0002.objective: Confirm a version not yet deployed anywhere can be deployed to staging or production as a selectable (non-default) version, after confirmation.
MODELS-0002.precondition: A version exists that is not currently deployed to any channel.

steps.name: Select the undeployed version
steps.expected: Its detail panel shows deploy actions for both staging and production.
steps.actual: 0.7.0-archive selected (Inactive); detail panel confirms both Deploy to Prod / Deploy to Staging actions exist (visible in next step's pre-shot).

steps.name: Choose to deploy it to a channel
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog explains the version will become a selectable deployment on that channel without replacing the current default.
steps.actual: Deploy-to-staging modal explains the version becomes a selectable model without changing the current default.

steps.name: Confirm the deployment
steps.expected: The version's lifecycle status shows it is now deployed to that channel (not yet default).
steps.actual: Deployed: Staging deployment banner now shows for 0.7.0-archive with no Default badge; toast confirms 'Model version ready 0.7.0-archive'.

MODELS-0003.title: Making a deployed version the channel default succeeds
MODELS-0003.objective: Confirm a version already deployed to a channel, but not yet its default, can be promoted to the default that mobile clients resolve.
MODELS-0003.precondition: A version is deployed to a channel but is not that channel's current default.

steps.name: Select the non-default deployed version
steps.expected: A "make default" action is available for that channel.
steps.actual: 0.7.0-archive selected; shown deployed to Staging (not yet default).

steps.name: Choose to make it the channel default
steps.expected: The version's lifecycle status now shows it as the default for that channel, and the previous default no longer shows as default.
steps.actual: Made default: toast 'Default staging model changed - 0.7.0-archive is default'; Deploy to Prod / Undeploy actions now shown for it.

MODELS-0004.title: Undeploying a version from a channel succeeds
MODELS-0004.objective: Confirm a deployed version can be removed from a channel after confirmation.
MODELS-0004.precondition: A version is currently deployed to a channel.

steps.name: Select the deployed version
steps.expected: An undeploy action is available for that channel.

steps.name: Choose to undeploy from the channel
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog appears naming the channel.
steps.actual: Undeploy-from-staging modal confirms removal, naming the channel and noting other deployed models remain.

steps.name: Confirm the undeploy
steps.expected: The version's lifecycle status no longer shows it deployed to that channel.
steps.actual: Undeployed: detail now shows 'Not deployed to staging or production'; toast 'staging undeployed - No default model is assigned to staging'.

MODELS-0005.title: Deleting a version that is still deployed is blocked
MODELS-0005.objective: Confirm the app refuses to delete a model version while it remains deployed to any channel, and explains why.
MODELS-0005.precondition: A version is currently deployed to at least one channel.

steps.name: Select the deployed version and locate the delete action
steps.expected: The delete action is disabled, with an explanation that the version must be undeployed first.
steps.actual: 1.0.0-seeds-v2 selected; Delete model button present but disabled (verified disabled=true, title='Undeploy this model before deleting it').

MODELS-0006.title: Deleting a version that is not deployed anywhere succeeds
MODELS-0006.objective: Confirm a version with no active deployments can be permanently deleted after confirmation.
MODELS-0006.precondition: A version exists that is not deployed to any channel.

steps.name: Select the undeployed version and choose to delete it
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog warns the deletion is permanent, covering the version, its artifacts, and its training run.
steps.actual: 0.7.0-archive selected (undeployed); delete confirmation dialog warns deletion is permanent, covering the version, its artifacts, and its training run.

steps.name: Confirm the deletion
steps.expected: The version no longer appears in the version list.
steps.actual: Confirmed deletion: 0.7.0-archive no longer appears anywhere in the version list (verified live).

MODELS-0007.title: Renaming a version to one that already exists is rejected
MODELS-0007.objective: Confirm the app enforces unique version names and shows an error rather than silently overwriting or duplicating.
MODELS-0007.precondition: At least two model versions exist.

steps.name: Select a version and start renaming it
steps.expected: An inline rename field is shown, pre-filled with the current name.

steps.name: Enter the exact name of a different, existing version and save
steps.expected: The rename is rejected with an error stating that name already exists; the version keeps its original name.
steps.actual: Renaming to '1.0.0-seeds-v2' rejected with error 'Version "1.0.0-seeds-v2" already exists.'
